metaDescription: Semrush is an online visibility platform for SEO, AI search visibility, content, competitor research and advertising. See its features, Free, SEO, Starter, Pro+ and Advanced pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Semrush is a marketing platform for SEO, content marketing, competitor research and paid search. It covers keyword research, site audits, rank tracking, backlinks and competitor analysis, plus separate toolkits for local SEO, content, traffic analysis and PR.

Semrush's main plans combine SEO with AI search visibility. The SEO plan covers keyword research, competitor analysis, Position Tracking and Site Audit; Starter, Pro+ and Advanced add more websites and keywords plus daily tracking of AI prompts in tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. A free plan gives limited daily access, paid plans have a 7-day free trial, and other toolkits, such as Local, Content and Traffic & Market, are sold separately.

features.title: Keyword research
features.text: Find keywords with volume, difficulty and intent data, and compare competitors with Keyword Gap.

features.title: Site Audit
features.text: Crawl your site to find technical SEO issues.

features.title: Position Tracking
features.text: Track keyword rankings across search engines and AI tools.

features.title: Competitor research
features.text: See competitors' organic rankings, traffic and backlinks.

features.title: AI search visibility
features.text: Track how your brand appears in AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini, with daily prompt tracking from Starter.

features.title: Content tools
features.text: Content optimization tools on Pro+ and higher, plus keyword optimization tools from Starter.

useCases: Rank tracking across search and AI
strengths: Covers SEO, AI search visibility, content, competitor research and ads in one platform.
A free plan with one demo project and 10 reports a day.
A 7-day free trial on the SEO, Starter and Pro+ plans.
limitations: The free plan is limited to one demo project and 10 reports a day.
Paid plans start at $139/mo billed monthly, or $117.33/mo billed yearly.
Daily AI prompt tracking starts with Starter at $199/mo.
Historical data and content optimization need Pro+ or higher.
Advanced is priced through sales, and extra users cost from $45/mo each.

pricing.summary: Free plan available, with no credit card needed. Prices below are billed monthly; yearly billing saves up to 17%. SEO, Starter and Pro+ have a 7-day free trial. Extra users cost from $45/mo each, and other toolkits, such as Local, Content and Traffic & Market, are priced separately.
